snippet.title: Back to the Dawn | Official Xbox Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Play Back To The Dawn now!
Xbox: https://www.xbox.com/en-us/games/store/back-to-the-dawn/9pkwjsj4nwc7
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1735700/Back_to_the_Dawn/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=social

We are excited to share that Back to the Dawn is out on Steam and Xbox on 18th July, 3AM UTC!

A gripping prison escape RPG woven with crime, corruption, and hidden agendas. Step into a maximum-security facility where every inmate has a past—and a plan. You'll have to fight to survive, investigate, and ultimately break free before the time runs out. Uncover a scheme that threatens more than just your life—it could bring down the entire city. In this thrilling adventure, choices matter, and escape is your only salvation!

Join our communities:

Official Twitter: https://twitter.com/backtothedawn
Official TikTok: https://www.tiktok.com/@backtothedawngame
Official Discord Server: https://discord.gg/eDZ5pkDruq
Spiral Up Games Twitter: https://twitter.com/SpiralUpGames
Spiral Up Games Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/SpiralUpGames
